content: {"like": ["The video presents a lot of information about the importance of American agriculture and agricultural machinery makers during WWII.", "It highlights revolutionary new agricultural products such as the Ford \"N\" series with the Ferguson hydraulic-operated 3-point hitch system and the Massey-Harris combines.", "It gives credit to farmers who went to war or fought to keep the world from starving as well as the women who were pressed into male roles in the factory and the farm.", "It mentions notable companies like John Deere, Allis Chalmers, and JI Case, and their contributions to war production.", "It is considered a good video for tractor enthusiasts."], "dislike": ["The DVD does not mention the work done by International Harvester, which built 7500 half-tracked armored personnel carriers.", "The reviewer would have liked to see more of the models that were allowed to be built during WWII."]}
